description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/blizzard-character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccountConfirmation" name="Account confirmation email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CharacterConfirmation" name="Character confirmation and character selfies"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release message"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CharacterGenerator">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Player" name="Player" processRef="Process_Player"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Blizzard" name="Blizzard online service"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AccountConfirmation"
                      name="Account confirmation email"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Blizzard"
                      targetRef="Event_AccountConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CharacterConfirmation"
                      name="Character confirmation and character selfies"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Blizzard"
                      targetRef="Event_CharacterConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ExpansionRelease"
                      name="Expansion release message"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Blizzard"
                      targetRef="Event_ExpansionRelease"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Player" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreateCharacter" name="Start creating a WoW character"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Set up account and come up with names"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check for a Battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Battle.net account exists?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_AccountConfirmation" name="Receive account confirmation email">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AccountConfirmation" messageRef="Message_AccountConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the confirmation link"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountMerge" name="Continue account setup"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckSubscription" name="Check for an active WoW subscription"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionActive" name="Active WoW subscription?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Payment method?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterIBAN" name="Enter IBAN"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBIC" name="Enter BIC"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Continue after payment details"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge" name="Continue account setup"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into the game"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRealm" name="Select realm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRace" name="Select race"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectClass" name="Select class"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ThinkOfNames" name="Come up with character names"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin" name="Account setup and names ready"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterName" name="Enter a character name"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check whether the character name is available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Name available?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CharacterConfirmation" name="Receive character confirmation and selfies">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CharacterConfirmation" messageRef="Message_CharacterConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionRelease" name="Receive a message when the expansion is released">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionRelease" messageRef="Message_ExpansionRelease"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complete" name="Receive expansion release message"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Parallel" sourceRef="Start_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Parallel_ThinkNames" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_ThinkOfNames"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_Exists" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInformation_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation" targetRef="Event_AccountConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_ClickLink" sourceRef="Event_AccountConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClickLink_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_CheckSubscription" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckSubscription"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSubscription_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionActive_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActive" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">activeSubscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionActive_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionActive" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not activeSubscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Card" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCardInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = 'credit card'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Bank" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterIBAN">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = 'bank account'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterIBAN_BIC" sourceRef="Task_EnterIBAN" targetRef="Task_EnterBIC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Card_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BIC_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBIC" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionMerge_LogIn" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogIn_SelectRealm" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Task_SelectRealm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectRealm_SelectRace" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealm" targetRef="Task_SelectRace"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectRace_SelectClass" sourceRef="Task_SelectRace" targetRef="Task_SelectClass"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectClass_Join" sourceRef="Task_SelectClass" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThinkNames_Join" sourceRef="Task_ThinkOfNames" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_EnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNamesJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Task_EnterName" targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Event_CharacterConfirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_No" name="No, try another name" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not nameAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CharacterConfirmation_ExpansionRelease" sourceRef="Event_CharacterConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ExpansionRelease"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionRelease_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionRelease" targetRef="End_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
